title: Ledger and Uniform
author: Wendell Iversen
blurb: August Voss, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must choose which family member gets the last berth before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
